pixel_description: Photorealistic cutaway: left large white 100mm PU cold box as single 2m cube with thick white foam walls roof floor and back wall visible in section, left outer panel and corner steel brackets, open white 900mm hinged door swung 90deg to right, box sits flat on common grey concrete plinth. Inside two low steel side racks left and right with centre aisle, each 3-high blue vented crates with tomatoes lettuce zucchini lemons. Ceiling centre high evaporator cassette with fan and fins blowing translucent blue downflow over crates. Copper pipes run along inside back wall, exit right wall and run down outside to grey DC chiller condenser box with fan on plinth. Orange DC cables loop from chiller to adjacent dark grey battery control cabinet and toward tilted 6-panel solar array on A-frame to far right. Adult man standing between door and battery gives scale: box roof just above head, door ~ man height, overall width ~3x man height ~5m. Touches: racks stand on box floor, crates stacked on racks, evaporator screwed to roof, pipes penetrate wall chiller to evaporator, cables terminal to chiller and battery, all units bear on plinth, door hinged to box front. Critical cold_box: drawn as one insulated enclosure of 5 foam panels plus hinged door, 2m class, anchored to plinth, containing 2 racks with aisle, supporting high evaporator, penetrated by cooling pipes, closed by sealed door - working section geometry as in sketch and engineers plan/section with 3-high crates and air gaps and separate PV rack.
comparison_with_previous: First evaluation, no previous render to compare.

deviations.measured: tilted ~30deg fixed-tilt 6-panel array on A-frame, ~0.6x box width in perspective, orange cable run on plinth toward battery
deviations.expected: horizontal long axis, 0.75x cold_box, touching dc_wiring
deviations.why: Tilt is required by design; apparent size small from perspective; electrical connection present via cables, power path unchanged.

deviations.measured: corner angle brackets vertical on box plus separate tilted A-frame under PV; combined fragment 0.38x box
deviations.expected: vertical long axis, 1.1x cold_box, touching cold_box
deviations.why: Design requires PV rack separate from cold box and box anchored to plinth; separation is intentional for wind load, support function unchanged.

deviations.measured: short orange cables plus copper pipes linking battery-chiller-box-PV along plinth, compact runs
deviations.why: Short low-loss runs are better; cables visibly touch/connect units at terminals, electrical continuity shown.

deviations.measured: dark grey cabinet ~0.3x box height on plinth next to chiller with small service gap, linked by orange cables
deviations.why: 400-800mm cabinet vs 2000mm box is correctly small; gap with cable connection is correct for electrical not mechanical joint.

deviations.measured: white box with corner brackets in contact, PV A-frame separate across plinth
deviations.why: Corner frame touches box; PV frame separation is required separate rack, not a missing support.

deviations.measured: ceiling cassette with fan ~0.3x box width plus large blue airflow plume filling box
deviations.why: Fan unit small but plume shows uniform low-velocity air over evaporator as required; cooling distribution unchanged.

deviations.measured: two steel side racks inside box 3-high, standing on insulated floor above plinth
deviations.why: Racks stand free inside box on floor which sits on plinth; indirect bearing via box floor is by design, ergonomic height preserved.

deviations.measured: 9 crates visible 3 left +6 right, 3-high with vent slots and produce, ~0.4m crates on racks
deviations.why: Partial load illustration for 60-crate store; count and apparent large size from close view do not change washable vented housing principle.

deviations.measured: grey outdoor unit with fan ~1.1x battery cabinet, beside battery with cable loop and copper pipes to box
deviations.why: Localizer missed but pixels show unit clearly; size similar to battery as specified 300-600mm, segmenter 6.6x includes pipes; cable/pipe connection provides thermal/electrical path.

deviations.measured: common grey concrete slab under box, chiller, battery and PV; racks bear via box floor
deviations.why: Raised slab carries 1-tonne plus box uniformly; direct rack-plinth gap is insulation thickness, load path intact.

s1_differences: Only illustrative differences: 9 crates visible vs 12 counted representing 60-crate full store, short cable/pipe runs, small service gaps between battery-chiller and racks-plinth via insulated floor, PV tilt perspective. Same 11 parts, same electrical thermal fluid mechanical connections, same relative sizes orientations and flow directions as sketch and hand sketches.
s2_feedback: Box fully bears on plinth, racks with centre aisle and 900mm door allow human reach, copper pipes and orange cables have clear runs without kinks, door swing clears chiller, PV rack separate so no extra wind on box; no interference, impossible assembly or failed load path seen.
notes: Segmenter sizes coarse x2 and long-axis only; localizer missed dc_chiller but it is clearly visible outside beside door. Callouts spelled correctly with no numbers and no extra text/scale bars. Photorealistic render, not diagram.
